mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO resource_admin_idempotency (id, actor_user_id, operation, idempotency_key, payload_hash, resource_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{actorUserId}, #{operation}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payloadHash}, #{resourceId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, actor_user_id, operation, idempotency_key, payload_hash, resource_id, created_at, updated_at FROM resource_admin_idempotency WHERE actor_user_id = #{actorUserId} AND operation = #{operation} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_admin_idempotency SET resource_id = #{resourceId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND resource_id IS NULL
